Notes: Guild Museum (GuildMuseum.cs): the doors into the Avalon and Khrysalis galleries, on the museum island beside the curator. Walk into one to enter its gallery; the door at the back of a gallery brings you back here. Move them in the Customs tab if they stand somewhere awkward.

Objects.Name: GuildMuseum_AvalonDoor
Objects.Notes: Guild-Museum-AvalonDoor: walking into it goes to the Avalon Gallery.

Objects.Name: GuildMuseum_KhrysalisDoor
Objects.Notes: Guild-Museum-KhrysalisDoor: walking into it goes to the Khrysalis Gallery.
